Sociolinguistic survey of the Tiquié: the Miriti-tapuya speak Tukano as their first language; local Tukano/Tuyuka tradition holds them to be of Nadahup (Makú) origin, which matches Koch-Grünberg's 1904 hearsay that their lost language was 'ugly like Makú' and bears on the languoid's identity (possibly not Tukanoan at all), not on its prosody. No Miriti forms.
